synthesizedFacts.fact: Sensitive skin is a common condition characterized by heightened reactivity to environmental factors and cosmetic products.
Sensitive skin can be caused by a variety of factors including dry skin, eczema, irritant contact dermatitis, and allergic reactions.
Management of sensitive skin involves avoiding irritants, using gentle skincare products, and maintaining skin hydration.
Sensitive skin is not a diagnosable condition but rather a symptom of other underlying skin issues.
